title: Evidence Review verdict v0
description: Structural shape of an evidence review verdict returned by POST /api/evidence/review. Semantic rules that a schema cannot express (the proof-boundary ceiling, REJECTED must stay INCONCLUSIVE) live in src/lib/evidence-review/validation.ts and run after this schema.

decision.description: Whether the submitted content is admissible evidence. ACCEPTED does not mean the criterion passed.

finding.description: What the admitted content shows about the criterion.

rationale.description: Why this verdict was reached, naming what was observed and which rule applied.

proofBoundary.description: The highest thing the submitted content actually proves. Never higher than the submitted source type, and never AUTO_VERIFIED, because reading pasted text cannot establish that the platform executed a check.

suggestedNextEvidence.description: What to submit next. Required in practice whenever the verdict is not ACCEPTED.
